 Dan Tennebaum - The Case for India at India Capital (EP.387) 
 
 Dan Tennebaum - The Case for India at India Capital (EP.387) May 23, 2024

 Dan Tennebaum is the Managing Director at India Capital, a
thirty-year-old investment firm focusing on public equities in
India. Dan moved to the country twenty-five years ago and spent
time in the start-up world and venture capital before pivoting to
the public markets in 2007. 

Our conversation covers Dan's path from a U.S. Midwesterner to
India, the challenges of venture capital investing in the country,
and the case for public equities. We turn to India Capital’s
perspective on sourcing, research, management, regulation,
valuation, portfolio construction, risk, and misperceptions,
colored with some examples along the way.

 About the Podcast 
 
 
 Allocator and asset management expert, Ted Seides, conducts in-depth interviews with leaders in the institutional investing industry. Guests include Chief Investment Officers from leading allocators, asset managers, strategists, thought leaders, and many more. Our mission is to learn, share, and help implement the process of premier investors. Learn more and join our community at capitalallocators.com.
